There are currently 35 legendaries (including mythics) that can be caught in Pokémon Infinite Fusion. Excluding the Kanto legendary birds, Entei, Mew, Jirachi, Meloetta, Cresselia, Darkrai, and Diancie, these Pokémon can only be obtained during the post-game (outside of Randomized Mode).

This page details the methods to obtain them.

Warning: This page contains spoilers about the main story.

Respawning Legendaries[]

Legendary Pokémon will disappear if defeated, caught or the player runs away. There are two ways to cause certain legendaries to respawn:

Defeating the Elite Four Pokémon Champion[]

This only works if you defeated or ran away from the Legendary. The following legendaries will reappear after defeating the Elite 4 Pokémon Champion for a second and all subsequent times, until caught:

  • Articuno
  • Zapdos
  • Moltres
  • Mew
  • Mewtwo
  • Ho-gia (Ho-oh/Lugia fusion) *
  • Rayquaza
  • Kyogre
  • Groudon
  • Genesect
  • Kyurem
  • Reshirom (Reshiram/Zekrom fusion)
  • Dialga
  • Palkia
  • Giratina
  • Regigigas
  • Regi (Ice/Steel)
  • Regi (Rock/Ice)
  • Regi (Steel/Rock)
  • Cresselia
  • Darkrai
  • Necrozma

While not being a Legendary, Rotom also respawns under the same conditions.

Clearing Mt. Silver[]

Certain legendaries will reappear after defeating Gold on Mt. Silver for the 1st time you defeat Gold regardless of whether they had previously been caught or defeated.

We recommend doing this after you've already caught the initial encounter of the Legendary. This essentially gives you a 2nd copy of the Pokémon below.

  • Articuno
  • Zapdos
  • Moltres
  • Mew
  • Raicune
  • Entei
  • Ho-oh/Lugia*
  • Mewtwo
  • Darkrai
  • Cresselia

*requires both defeating the Pokémon Champion and Gold.

-Note: Any legendaries not listed above will not respawn once defeated; the player must start a new game or use Wonder Trade or the Celadon City Black Market in order to obtain them-

Obtainable Legendaries[]

Articuno[]

Location Seafoam Island (Route 20)
HMs Needed Surf
Level 50
Requirement: Ice Pick from Mt. Ember

During the Team Rocket event in Cinnabar Island, after beating Giovanni and the fused birds. You will find the Ice Pick in front of where Moltres was, which you can use to climb the ice wall in Seafoam Island to reach Articuno.

Zapdos[]

Location Power Plant
HMs Needed None
Level 50
Requirement Power Plant Access Key from Mt. Ember

During the Team Rocket event in Cinnabar Island, after beating Giovanni and the fused birds. You will find the Power Plant Access Key in front of where Moltres was, which can be used inside the power plant north of rock tunnel to unlock a door blocking the way to the Power Plant's basement. Beyond the first door, you will need to collect several Cell Batteries to power a second door that's blocking the way to Zapdos.

Moltres[]

Location Mt. Ember
HMs Needed Surf, Strength
Level 50

During the Team Rocket event in Cinnabar Island, after beating Giovanni and the fused birds, Moltres will return to its original spot. After getting a message saying that it's looking at you intensely, it can be challenged to a battle any time.

Mewtwo[]

Location Cerulean Cave
HMs Needed Surf, Waterfall, Flash
Level 60

After beating the game, Professor Oak will ask you to go talk to his colleague, Professor Elm in New Bark Town. If you have obtained at least 2 Johto badges, Professor Elm will give you HM05 Waterfall, which allows you to enter Cerulean Cave. Mewtwo is found at the very end.

Mew[]

Location Mt. Moon Summit
HMs Needed Strength
Level 30
Requirements 20+ Karma

If the player has at least 20 Karma and has found all 8 Constellations. Mew can be encountered by using the telescope in the Mt. Moon observatory and moving the center dot to collide with the Mew that spawns. if you don't see Mew, but hear its cry, that means you need more Positive Karma.

Entei[]

Location Victory Road Roaming (Johto)
HMs Needed Strength None
Level 45 45
Requirements None Defeat Entei in Victory Road instead of catching it.

Entei can be encountered on the second floor of Victory Road. If it is defeated, it will start roaming around the Johto region. When roaming, it can be tracked using the Weather Tracker obtained at the Ruins of Alph; it will cause sunny weather at its current location.

Raikou / Suicune[]

Location Roaming (Johto)
HMs Needed None
Level 50

Raikou and Suicune are fused together as Raicune when you encounter them. 

When you enter Violet City, you will encounter Eusine, who says he has been tracking a legendary Pokémon. Follow him to the Ruins of Alph go down the basement of chamber A to find Raicune at the end. It will flee and start roaming around Johto. You can speak to a scientist in the ruins of Alph to obtain a Weather Tracker to track it more easily; it will cause a storm at its current location.

Ho-Oh / Lugia[]

Location Navel Rock
HMs Needed Surf, Waterfall
Level 60

Lugia and Ho-Oh are fused together as Ho-Gia when you encounter them.

On Boon Island, one of the residents tells you about Navel Rock. After speaking to him, go north to find Chuck. Defeat him and he will give you the Navel Ticket. Then show the pass to the sailor in the harbor and he will agree to take you to Navel Rock. Climb to the top to encounter Ho-Gia.

Celebi[]

Location Ilex Forest
HMs Needed None
Level 30
Requirement Have the GS Ball in your inventory

After completing 50 hotel quests, the man on the top floor of hotels will give you the GS Ball. Place it in the shrine in Ilex Forest to encounter Celebi.

Groudon[]

Location Ruby Chamber at Mt. Ember
HMs Needed Surf, Dive
Level 60

Climb up Mt. Ember and enter the Ruby Chamber. A NPC will give you some heat-protection cream in exchange for a Fire Gem, which you can find in the Cinnabar Poké Mart. This will allow you to explore deeper in the cave. Next, you will need to find a ruby. To find it go right, left, right. When taking the ladders. Once you have the ruby, go back up the ladders till you are back to the beginning. Then to get to groudon, take the ladders in this order: left, right, left. When at the bottom, walk up to the lava pool and interact with it. This will start the groudon encounter. After the encounter, a portal will be open that takes you back to the top of Mt. Ember.

Warning: There will be a red hue over the screen during all of this.

Kyogre[]

Location Sapphire Cave in Deep Sea (Sevii Islands)
HMs Needed Surf, Dive, Flash
Level 60

Go to the Deep Ocean, South of Brine Road and use Dive on the diving spot. You can dive deeper by going down the crevice in the middle. Keep in mind the deeper you go down the darker the rooms get, you will need to use flash to see. To start, you will need to find a sapphire. The path for it will be, right, right, then lastly down. After you have gotten the sapphire, you'll need to get to Sapphire Cave. Start by going back the first cave under the crevice, then take this path right, left, down, then lastly far right (there are three entrances). Once in the cave you find Kyogre, talking to it will start the encounter. After the encounter, a portal will be open that takes you back to the entrance of the Deep Sea.

Rayquaza[]

Location Sky Pillar
HMs Needed None
Level 70
Requirement Encounter Kyogre and Groudon

Once you have encountered both Groudon and Kyogre, talk to one of the residents on Kin Island. Follow him to the harbor and he will take you to Sky Pillar. Navigate to the top of the tower and encounter Rayquaza. (Unlike Ruby, Sapphire, and Emerald, the Bicycle is not required to navigate the tower.)

Regigigas / Regirock / Registeel / Regice[]

Location Submerged Temple
HMs Needed Surf, Dive, Strength
Level 60

Starting from Chrono Island, make your way through the Water Labyrinth to the diving spot in the middle. Use Dive to get underwater. While you are underwater, you will find a temple the entrance is blocked by rocks, so you go east and get through the a hole. You will need to use Strength to push the boulders. While you push the boulder, you will get chased by a Sharpedo. If you get caught you will be kicked outside. To avoid it, you need to get to the hole on the wall. on the first hole you will get an item. On the second hole, you don't want to go too far because there is a sharpedo in the end of the room. On the third hole there is nothing. On the fourth hole you will get into the Submerged temple.

You can get a Regi plate on the west hole. The regi tablet is used to translate the carved wall in the submerged temple. In the temple, there are three doors. Each door can only be opened by a Steel/Rock, Rock/Ice, and Ice/Steel Pokémon. Each door will lead you to sealed chamber, you will need to solve the puzzle on each sealed chamber get Regirock, Registeel, Regice. You will need to encounter all of them to open a hole that leads to Regigigas.

Dialga / Palkia / Giratina[]

Pokémon All 3 Eggs Dialga Palkia Giratina
Location Sinjoh Ruins Boon Island Blackthorn City Route 4
HMs Needed None Rock Climb Rock Climb Rock Climb
Level 1 75 75 75
Requirement Have Arceus in your party Complete Mt. Silver Complete Mt. Silver Complete Mt. Silver

After catching Arceus, go back to see Mr. Pokémon on Route 30 with Arceus in your party. He will take you to the Sinjoh Ruins. Talk to Cynthia and go to enter the ruins. This will trigger a cutscene after which you will receive 3 eggs. The eggs contain Dialga, Palkia and Giratina. With this method you can hatch the eggs and obtain the three legendaries at lvl 1.

You can also get a second set after the encounter on Mt. Silver. You can find three "Strange Vortex" that lead to the legendaries, but at level 75. Palkia is in Blackthorn City near the cave where you first came out to reach the city. Dialga is on Boon Island at the highest mountain. Giratina is on Route 4 near the exit of Mt. Moon where the side of the mountain has a different texture.

Darkrai/Cresselia[]

Location Lavender Town/Halfmoon Island/Moonlit Forest/Fullmoon Island/Newmoon Island
HM Needed Surf or Fly
Level 50 or 60

First the player must collect the Bedroom Key from the Goldenrod Department Store's basement, which will be able to open the back room of the Lavender Orphanage (South-easternmost house of Lavender Town). In that room, there will be a feather on the bed. Interacting with the feather triggers a cutscene where a voice tells you to collect feathers, which only appear at night.

During nighttime, shadowy figures will appear, and interacting with them gives hints to the location of the next feather. The first feather is in the northernmost house in Vermillion City, east of the Pokémon Center. The second feather is up the stairs of the daycare south of Cerulean City. The third feather is located in the hotel of Fuschia City. The fourth feather is located north of Crimson City, in the house on an island. Finally, the fifth feather is located back in the Lavender Orphanage, collecting it will lower the player's Karma by 5. Speak to the green feather after that and go to bed and the player will wake up in Halfmoon Island. Speaking to Darkrai will trigger a cutscene, and now you have a path to choose.

North of Halfmoon Island is Moonlit Forest, where there's a forest clearing with water in the shape of a crescent moon. Walking on the water will make it disappear/reappear; if you make all of the water disappear, it will resemble a new moon and give you access to Newmoon Island when you leave the forest, and if you make all of the water reappear it will resemble a full moon and give you access to Fullmoon Island.

The Cresselia Path[]

To take this path, enter Moonlit Forest and fill the area with water, resembling a full moon, and leave the forest to enter Fullmoon Island, where Cresselia and a bed is located. Interacting with Cresselia will give you a Lunar Feather, which Cresselia tells the player to place on the bed in Newmoon Island. Go back to Moonlit Forest and make the area of water into a new moon and enter Newmoon Island.

Placing the Lunar Feather on the bed in Newmoon Island resets the players's Karma, and takes them to a dreamish version of Moonlit Forest, where many Mareep and Flaaffy are located. The goal is to count how many Mareep there are (including the shiny ones) and how many Flaaffy there are (watch out for the shiny Mareep who are the same color as the Flaaffy). To the east is a Drowzee, who asks the player to count the number of Mareep and Flaaffy in the forest; miscounting the Pokémon will cause you to re-count with a different amount of Mareep and Flaaffy for each failure you do. After completing the minigame, the player wakes up on Newmoon Island, now with less corruption, where Cresselia will join your party, and Darkrai can be battled and caught.

The Darkrai Path[]

To take this path, enter Moonlit Forest and make all the water disappear, resembling a new moon, and leave the forest to enter Newmoon Island, where Darkrai and a bed is located. Interacting Darkrai will give you a Corrupted Feather. Go back to Moonlit Forest and make the area of water into a full moon and enter Fullmoon Island.

Placing the Corrupted Feather on the bed lowers the player's Karma by -20, and takes them to a nightmarish version of Moonlit Forest. South is a patch of water, where walking into it will turn the player into a Magikarp. Pressing Space/X will make the player jump forwards one tile, and holding Space/X until a spark appears and pressing Space/X again makes them jump forwards two tiles. The aim is to complete the course before a shadowy Pinsir catches up to the player. After completing the mini-game, the player wakes up on Fullmoon Island, now more corrupted, where Darkrai will join their party, and Cresselia can be battled and caught.

Once either path has been completed, return to the bed in Halfmoon Island. This will take you back to the Lavender Orphanage.

Arceus[]

Location Hall of Origin
HMs Needed None
Level 60
Requirement Have the Azure Flute stone in your inventory

After catching Articuno, Zapdos, Moltres, Entei, Raikou and Suicune, go to the Ruins of Alph and talk to Eusine. After that go to Eusine’s house in Cherrygrove city and let his Dittos copy the 6 legendary Pokémon. He will give you the Azure Flute. Go to Mr. Pokémon on Route 30 and talk to him. Afterwards, go to the Ice Mountains, north of Blackthorn City in Johto, and find the Ice Cavern. Climb up the stairs until you reach the mountain's peak. Walk into the circle on the ground and use the Azure Flute to reveal a staircase to the Hall of Origin, where you will encounter Arceus.

Genesect[]

Location P2 Laboratory
HMs Needed None
Level 60

Go to the Rocket Warehouse on Chrono Island. You will come across two Team Plasma grunts. Follow them to the harbor and the sailor will take you to P2 Laboratory. Once you’re there, enter the building and defeat the three Plasma grunts. Enter the backroom to find a room with a vat in the middle. Interact with it to encounter Genesect.

The various drives needed for Genesect’s signature move are found on the ground in the laboratory.

Reshiram / Zekrom[]

Location Bell Tower
HMs Needed None
Level 70

Reshiram and Zekrom are fused together as Reshirom when you encounter them.

Go to the dance hall in Ecruteak City and fight all the Kimono girls, then speak to Alder. He will give you the Light Stone and the Dark Stone. Make your way to the top of the Bell Tower and interact with the bell to encounter Reshirom.

Kyurem[]

Location Lake of Rage
HMs Needed None
Level 70
Requirement Have the Dark and Light stone in your inventory

Go to the dance hall in Ecruteak City and fight all the Kimono girls, then speak to Alder. He will give you the Light Stone and the Dark Stone. After that, head over to the Lake of Rage. Interact with the icy stone and the lake will freeze over. Navigate the ice puzzle and make your way to the center of the lake to find Kyurem.

Latias / Latios[]

Location Roaming (Sevii Islands)
HMs Needed None
Level 50

Enter Boon Island's Pokémon Center and interact with the TV. A report will mention two dragon Pokémon from Hoenn that were sighted in the Sevii Islands. Two different fusions of Latias and Latios will both start roaming around the Sevii Islands from that point on. You can use the Weather Tracker obtained in the Ruins of Alph to track their locations; they will cause strong winds at their current location.

Deoxys[]

Location Birth Island
HMs Needed Waterfall, Surf, Dive
Level 70

A girl at the Kin Island's hotel mentions that she saw a meteor crash around Bond Bridge and asks you to go investigate. North of the bridge you will find a waterfall. Climb up to find two secret agent type NPCs around a small crater. Talk to them and they will ask you to find the other pieces of an alien spaceship. The first one is located on Route 32 near a ledge. The second one is underwater on Route 19, South of Fuschia. You have to find the dive spot on route 20 and then head east to find it. After finding the two pieces, go back to the secret agent near Bond Bridge and they will use the locations of the pieces to triangulate the location of the mothership. It is located on Birth Island. Ask the sailor in Cinnabar Island's harbour to take you there. Once on Birth Island you will find another spaceship part. Interact with it and it will start floating around. Interact with it twice more and Deoxys will appear.

Jirachi[]

Location Dream
HMs Needed None
Level 20
Requirement Have encountered 777 unique Pokémon (not including legendaries)

After having encountered at least 777 unique Pokémon, go to any hotel and sleep for any amount of time. Instead of ending up on the upper floor of the hotel like usual, you will be teleported to a strange, dream version of Pallet Town. Go inside the lab and speak to Jirachi. After asking you to pick a Pokémon it will challenge you to a fight. No matter the outcome of the fight, you will wake up in your room with Jirachi in your party or PC. The Jirachi you fight will not match the Jirachi you find in your PC, even if you catch it. (So if the Jirachi you fight is Shiny, odds are slim that the one in your PC will be shiny).[1]

Necrozma[]

Location Mt. Moon
HMs Needed Surf, Waterfall, Flash, Cut
Level 70

Go to the top of the Pokémon Tower in Lavender Town to get the quest for Strange Prisms. Then go to Mt. Moon, Cerulean Cave, Mt. Mortar, and Rock Tunnel to get the Strange Prisms and return them to the pedestals on top of the Pokémon Tower. If all of this is done correctly, light should start getting sucked up and you will have to use TM Flash in order to go back to the base of Pokémon tower. From there go to Route 7, and pick up the another Strange Prism. Next you'll go to Celadon, and meet Sabrina on top of the Mall roof. Next, go to Fuchsia City and put the Strange Prism on the pedestal next to Koga, which will cause strange plants to start growing. These plants can be Cut. Follow the plants to the Safari Zone and proceed to the upper left corner of Area 3 to get the Strange Fruit, then go to the Pallet Town Dock to have professor Oak analyze it. He will then ask you to go north to find out what is happening. Go back to Mt. Moon and into the cave where you found the Strange Prism, where there should be intense glowing and another tunnel from that cave will finally lead you to Necrozma.

Meloetta[]

Location Saffron City
HMs Needed Surf, Cut, Strength, Rock Smash
Level 50

To start the quest, go into the Saffron bar during the day on a Saturday, go downstairs and there will be a concert. Walk into the bathroom and wait (there's a time skipping NPC for convenience) until night (8pm), where you start the quest. Return here after completing each part of the quest below to unlock the next part. After starting the quest you'll find the drummer, North of Crimson City on a small island, return to Saffron, Then you'll need 2 guitarists; one is in Goldenrod underground on Friday. Give it ₽4000 and then talk to it. The other is in Oricorio Clearing, south of Treasure Beach during Wednesday evenings (5-8pm). After getting the 3 musicians, return to the Saffron, you then will need to go to the Mt. Moon Observatory by going through a southern Mt. Moon entrance on the Cerulean side. When at the Observatory on a Monday morning (5-10am), clouds will appear where you have to parkour to reach the harpist. The last musician you need is found in Ilex Forest on Tuesday night(8-12pm), behind a cut tree on the right. Slowly tap (not hold) the up button as you approach to not scare the sleeping Pokémon. Once you have all 5 musicians, return to the band and they'll tell you there's a concert on Saturday night. After attending the concert, Meloetta will appear. Talk to it and it will join your party.

Tip: Get the sleeping bag from doing 20 hotel quests to make getting the specific times and dates easier.

Diancie[]

Location Pinkan Hollow
HMs Needed None
Level 30

After completing Operation Shutdown (Quest), go to Goldenrod City and talk to either Archen in the tunnel/dept. store basement, or the Police to the left of the train station. They will begin the Pinkan Island! quest. It does not matter who you help, you will get Diancie regardless of who you chose. For details on how to complete it see Pinkan Island. Upon completing it you will receive Diancie, as well as any other pokémon caught there.

If you try to join Team Rocket later in the game, such as after beating Mt. Silver, the Nugget Bridge grunt will be gone, however you can talk to a grunt in the Goldenrod City Tunnel to join Team Rocket and immediately start the Pinkan Island! quest.
